summary: Submitted a follower-prefix execution for the startup-replay question: a real three-voter cluster commits 8,400 commands, one follower stages its own committed prefix, and only that follower is restarted, with and without a snapshot taken on that follower. Native feedback showed the snapshot case returning immediately and the 132-batch replay never returning, so the retained receipt should extend the finding from a single-node leader prefix to the operational follower restart.
